title: Yuan Shao Fights Gongsun Zan at the Pan River; Sun Jian Crosses the Yangtze to Attack Liu Biao
summary: The alliance turns on itself. Yuan Shao takes Ji province by a trick and then meets Gongsun Zan at the bridge over the Pan River, where Gongsun Zan is unhorsed and about to die — and is saved by a young officer in white, a stranger, who gives his name as Zhao Yun of Changshan.
In the south, Yuan Shu goads Sun Jian into attacking Liu Biao. Sun Jian pursues too far into the hills at Xianshan and is crushed under a rockfall and a volley of arrows. He is thirty-seven.
history: Both battles are historical. Zhao Yun's arrival at the bridge is the novel's staging — a way of putting him on the board early, and in Liu Bei's line of sight.

pins.note: Takes Ji province, then fights Gongsun Zan at the bridge.
Unhorsed, and saved by a stranger.
First appearance: a young officer in white.
Killed in the hills south of Xiangyang, aged thirty-seven.
Seventeen, and now head of the family.
